6912.title: ACP pending-session cancellation gap
6912.rootCauseOneLine: Stop only addresses registered sessions and does not cancel in-flight construction, allowing a stopped start or replacement to become live.

prReviews.verdict: STATIC ONLY — targets the root cause
prReviews.topFinding: Pending-start cancellation is checked after both pre-registration waits; the PR was not run.

6912.proposedFix: Record pending constructions before the first await, cancel them on stop, check before launch, and clean the records in finally. Existing PR #6913 prevents a duplicate fix PR.
6912.caveats: Bridge-level Linux/fake-agent proof only; UI, macOS and third-party agents were not exercised. The same agent repeated both clean runs.
